expectations.evidence: dashboard.component.ts declares statsResource, activityResource, alertsResource as three separate httpResource instances, each with independent URL and retry counter
Template uses @else if (statsResource.hasValue()), @else if (activityResource.hasValue()), @else if (alertsResource.hasValue()) before every .value() call
Each panel has @else if (xResource.error()) branch showing error message and Retry button
retryStats(), retryActivity(), retryAlerts() increment private signal counters which are read inside the httpResource request function, triggering re-execution
alertsResource uses parse: (raw) => AlertsResponseSchema.parse(raw) with a full Zod schema (AlertSchema with id, severity enum, message, createdAt datetime)
dashboard.component.spec.ts imports { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest' — no jasmine APIs
Tests use appRef.whenStable() and fixture.whenStable() after flushing HTTP responses (flushAll helper calls both). ApplicationRef is injected and used throughout
